[[Darth Zhorrid]], a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], owned an '''estate''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], the Empire's [[Capital/Legends|capital]]. Zhorrid spent her free time at her estates on Dromund Kaas as well as the planets [[Sernpidal/Legends|Sernpidal]] and [[Begeren]], where she indulged in a variety of luxuries and horrors until she was sent elsewhere by her [[Parent/Legends|father]] [[Darth Jadus]].<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Darth Zhorrid's estates were first mentioned in the Codex entry for the Sith Lord in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Codex" />
